scope: reviewed FlashInfer 0.2.8 fa2 SDK configuration; MLA core Z/natural LSE
cache_scope: one input / 16 rotating input sets; no guaranteed cold cache
event_scope: captured complete SDK core including split partials/combine and graph allocations; excludes plan/JIT/H2D/layout/reference
